summary: Hood River County, OR: a cabin built 1934 on Shellrock Mountain, removed or destroyed in 1945; only communications wire is reported on the site.

facts.location: Mount Hood National Forest, Hood River County, Oregon
facts.status_note: Cabin gone since 1945; sources say removed or destroyed. Only a tangle of communications wire is reported on the summit

access.note: Reached on foot by a short, off-trail bushwhack from the Surveyor's Ridge Trail; no maintained trail to the summit

visit.trail_note: No maintained trail to the summit; a short bushwhack up from Surveyors Ridge Trail #688. Watershed signs on the approach warn hikers to stay on the trail

facts.agency: U.S. Forest Service, Mount Hood National Forest

events.note: Register and Forest Lookouts say removed; firelookout.com and Oregon Hikers say destroyed
Registered September 20, 2010 as US 648, OR 80; nominated by Ray Kresek

evidence.supports: location: Mount Hood National Forest, Hood River County, Oregon

evidence.quote: A cabin was built in 1934 and removed in 1945.

evidence.supports: destroyed in 1945; only communications wire remains
evidence.quote: The lookout cabin which was once here was destroyed in 1945 and the only evidence that remains is a tangle of some of the communications wire.

evidence.supports: no maintained trail to the summit; short bushwhack from Surveyors Ridge Trail
evidence.quote: Once the site of a lookout, Shellrock Mountain now has no maintained trail to its summit, but it's a short and easy bushwhack up from the Surveyor's Ridge Trail.

evidence.supports: USGS volcano monitoring station further down the west ridge
evidence.quote: Down the west ridge of Shellrock Mountain, there's a solar-powered USGS volcano monitoring station.

evidence.supports: signs at the approach mark the watershed edge and warn hikers to stay on the trail
evidence.quote: warn you not to leave the trail
A cabin was built in 1934 and removed in 1945.

evidence.supports: forest name: Mount Hood National Forest

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register and Forest Lookouts say removed in 1945; firelookout.com and Oregon Hikers say destroyed in 1945. The year agrees in all four; only the word differs.

notes_for_editor: Dates agree across sources; the removed/destroyed wording differs. The record's kind 'ground' is kept; sources describe a cabin, not a tower, so no design is added beyond that. Access is set to public because the Oregon Hikers guides describe a walk to the site, but the Dalles Watershed boundary signs were not checked against land rules, so a human should confirm before recommending the bushwhack. Today's description rests on one Oregon Hikers field guide, with no date shown. No staffing source found. No photos added.
